prompt:
Search the web now for news on each stock below. You are a financial fact extractor for a
pre-market brief. Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

VERIFIED TAPE (from exchange OHLC data; authoritative, do not restate different prices):
| Ticker | Company | Cap | Screen | 1D close | 5D | Vol× 10d | Vol/gap event |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| HPE | Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company | Large | Top 10 · 1D return · Large cap | +7.36% | +10.2% | 1.4× | — |
| STM | STMicroelectronics N.V. | Large | Top 10 · 1D return · Large cap | +7.03% | +10.3% | 1.9× | — |
| MTSI | MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. | Large | Top 10 · 1D return · Large cap | +6.62% | +12.6% | 1.0× | — |
| ON | ON Semiconductor Corporation | Large | Top 10 · 1D return · Large cap | +6.01% | +10.0% | 1.9× | — |

TASK
Run a separate search for EACH ticker ("<company> stock news", "<company> shares <session date>").
Find why it moved on Friday October 2, 2026, any after-hours / pre-market move on Monday October 5, 2026, and
other material news in the window. Search press releases (BusinessWire, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire),
SEC filings, FDA, Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily,
company IR pages, analyst-action roundups.
If a mover has no company news, check whether another company's event moved it (customer, supplier,
competitor, partner, sector report) and name that company and event.

OUTPUT (markdown; one section per ticker, in the order given; no intro or conclusion):

## Company Name (TICKER) `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or a concise sector name (Pharma, Energy, Retail, ...).
If you find nothing, write exactly one bullet: "- No company-specific catalyst found in window" and,
if applicable, a second bullet naming the sympathy driver.

Include when available: catalyst for the move, earnings figures, guidance, analyst actions, contracts
with $ size, filings, regulatory decisions, management quotes with numbers, next catalyst date.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (HPE) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- HPE shares rose **7.36% on October 2** after investor-day disclosures, analyst price-target increases, and a broader technology-sector rally; the investor day included a **$1.2 billion order from Vultr** for Helios AI server racks powered by AMD chips and deployed at Vultr’s U.S. data centers. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2 18:34 GMT-5)
- HPE raised its fiscal-2027 networking-revenue growth outlook to **high-teens to low-20%**, from **14%-17%** previously; it projected data-center networking revenue growth in the **low- to mid-50% range annually through fiscal 2029** and networking operating margins in the **mid- to high-20% range**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2 18:34 GMT-5)
- HPE reported fiscal third-quarter 2026 revenue of **$12.21 billion** and non-GAAP EPS of **$1.11**, versus consensus EPS of **$0.95**; fiscal-fourth-quarter guidance was **$13.9-$14.8 billion** of revenue and **$1.20-$1.30** of non-GAAP EPS. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2 11:30 GMT-3)
- HPE raised fiscal-2026 revenue-growth guidance to **34%-37%** and non-GAAP EPS guidance to **$3.75-$3.85**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2 11:30 GMT-3)
- **Daiwa Securities Group** upgraded HPE from **Neutral to Outperform** and set a **$75** price target on October 2. (MarketBeat, Oct. 2; publication time not stated)
- **Citigroup** raised its HPE price target to **$92 from $76** while maintaining a **Buy** rating. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2 18:34 GMT-5)
- The September U.S. employment report showed **29,000** nonfarm payroll additions versus an **84,000** consensus estimate; the unemployment rate was **4.2% versus 4.1% expected**, contributing to the broader equity-market move cited in coverage. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2 18:34 GMT-5)

## STMicroelectronics N.V. (STM) `[Analog & Mixed-Signal]`
- STMicroelectronics shares rose **7.03% on October 2**; coverage linked the move to semiconductor-sector and AI-demand gains rather than to a new company-specific operating announcement. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct. 3; publication time not stated)
- STMicroelectronics reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of **$3.49 billion**, versus **$3.46 billion** expected, and adjusted EPS of **$0.31**, versus **$0.26** expected; revenue increased **26% year over year** and gross margin was **34.8%**. (MarketBeat, Oct. 2; publication time not stated)
- Management’s prior third-quarter 2026 revenue outlook was **$3.70 billion at the midpoint**, representing **6.2% sequential growth** and **16.2% year-over-year growth**. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct. 3; publication time not stated)
- STMicroelectronics announced that it will release third-quarter 2026 results before European trading opens on **October 29, 2026**, followed by a conference call at **4:30 a.m. ET**. (Business Insider, Oct. 5 06:41 ET)
- **UBS** maintained a **Buy** rating and an **€80** price target in the analyst information cited in the October 3 coverage. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct. 3; publication time not stated)

## MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. (MTSI) `[Optical & Photonics]`
- MACOM shares rose **6.62% on October 2**; the available coverage cited no new October 2 company release, filing, contract, or analyst action as the immediate catalyst. (MarketBeat, Oct. 2; publication time not stated)
- MACOM’s latest reported quarter, released on **August 6**, showed EPS of **$1.40** versus consensus of **$1.35** and revenue of **$342.24 million** versus consensus of **$336.08 million**; revenue increased **35.8% year over year**. (MarketBeat, Oct. 2; publication time not stated)
- **BMO** had a recent price target of **$335**, while **Needham** had a recent price target of **$410**; the cited consensus rating was **Moderate Buy** with an average price target of **$341.25**. (MarketBeat, Oct. 2; publication time not stated)

## ON Semiconductor Corporation (ON) `[Power & Wide-Bandgap]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.
